method.calibration: Use 36 separate ordinary source works per genre with the same input lengths as the held files. Freeze per-genre cutoffs with strict exceedance for both prior operating rules.
method.candidate: Compare the stronger rank, smaller rank and arithmetic mean of the two ranks. Each calibrated policy requires one unique strongest above-point location per submitted document.
method.fit: For each genre use 48 separate five-sentence ordinary source excerpts to set the three token-length references. Record one maximum per measure, length bin and work, using the same three interior positions as the held files.
method.held: Select new source works for fitting, calibration and held measurement. Exclude the government-transfer panel and all its earlier research exclusions. The frozen scores and rank rules from the first comparison remain in effect.
method.ranks: Use the fraction of those work maxima strictly below the same-location reading, divided by n+1. Use classifier response in its native adjacent context and writing-pattern response on the exact sentence. Require at least 12 reference works in a length bin. Never substitute a missing or expanded ratio.
method.utility: Measure source-linked overlap, wrong positions and ordinary flags. Comparison includes every admitted file.
